verses.text: Ahab get 70 sons for Samaria. Jehu write letters and send dem go Samaria, to di leaders of Jezreel, di elders, and to dem wey dey raise Ahab pikin dem, say,
“Now as dis letter reach una, since una oga pikin dem dey with una, and chariots and horses dey with una, and strong city and weapons,
choose di best and di most fit among una oga pikin dem, put am for im papa throne and fight for una oga house.”
But dem fear well well and talk say, “Look, two kings no fit stand before am. How we go fit stand?”

Di one wey dey over di house, and di one wey dey over di city, di elders and di ones wey dey raise di pikin dem send to Jehu say, “We be your servants, and we go do all wey you tell us. We no go make anybody king. Do wetin good for your eyes.”

Den e write letter to dem di second time say, “If una dey my side, and if una go listen to my voice, take di heads of di men wey be una oga pikin dem and come to me for Jezreel by dis time tomorrow.” Now di king pikin dem, 70 men, dey with di big men of di city wey dey raise dem.
E happen say as di letter reach dem, dem take di king pikin dem and kill dem, 70 men, put dem heads for baskets and send dem to am for Jezreel.
One messenger come tell am say, “Dem don bring di heads of di king pikin dem.” E talk say, “Put dem for two heaps for di entrance of di gate until morning.”
E happen for morning say e go out, stand and talk to all di people say, “Una no get fault. Look, I plan against my oga and kill am, but who kill all dis ones?
Know now say nothing of di word of di Lord, wey di Lord talk against Ahab house, go fall to di ground, because di Lord don do wetin e talk by im servant Elijah.”
So Jehu kill all wey remain of Ahab house for Jezreel, and all im big men, and im close friends, and im priests, until e no leave anybody for am.
E stand up and go Samaria. As e dey for di meeting house of di shepherds for road,
Jehu meet di brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah and talk say, “Who una be?” Dem answer say, “We be di brothers of Ahaziah, and we dey go down to greet di king pikin dem and di queen mother pikin dem.”
E talk say, “Catch dem alive.” Dem catch dem alive and kill dem for di pit of di meeting house, 42 men. E no leave any of dem.

As e leave there, e meet Jehonadab, Rechab pikin, wey dey come meet am, and e greet am and talk to am say, “Your heart dey right toward me, as my heart dey toward your heart?” Jehonadab answer say, “E dey.” “If e dey, give me your hand.” E give am im hand, and e carry am up to am enter di chariot.
E talk say, “Come with me and see my zeal for di Lord.” So dem make am ride for im chariot.
As e reach Samaria, e kill all wey remain of Ahab for Samaria, until e destroy dem, as di word of di Lord wey e talk to Elijah.
Jehu gather all di people together and talk to dem say, “Ahab serve Baal small, but Jehu go serve am plenty.

Now call to me all di prophets of Baal, all im servants and all im priests. Make nobody lack, because I get big sacrifice for Baal. Anybody wey lack no go live.” But Jehu do am with trick, so that e go destroy di servants of Baal.
Jehu talk say, “Announce holy gathering for Baal.” Dem announce am.
Jehu send through all Israel, and all di servants of Baal come, so tay nobody remain wey no come. Dem enter di house of Baal, and di house of Baal full from one end to di other.
E talk to di one wey dey over di wardrobe say, “Bring clothes out for all di servants of Baal.” E bring dem clothes out.
Jehu and Jehonadab, Rechab pikin, go enter di house of Baal, and e talk to di servants of Baal say, “Look well and see make servant of di Lord no dey here with una, but only di servants of Baal.”

Den dem go in to offer sacrifices and burnt sacrifices. Jehu don put 80 men outside for im side, and talk say, “If anybody among di men wey I bring into una hands escape, im life go be for di life of am.”

E happen say as e finish to offer di burnt sacrifice, Jehu talk to di guards and di captains say, “Go in, kill dem. Make nobody come out.” Dem strike dem with di edge of sword, and di guards and di captains throw dem out, and dem go to di inner room of di house of Baal.
Dem bring out di pillars of di house of Baal and burn dem.
Dem break down di pillar of Baal, break down di house of Baal, and make am place for toilet till today.
So Jehu destroy Baal from Israel.
But Jehu no turn away from di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin, di gold calves wey dey Bethel and wey dey Dan.
Di Lord talk to Jehu say, “Because you do well to do wetin good for my eyes, and don do to Ahab house all wey dey my heart, your pikin dem to di fourth generation go sit for di throne of Israel.”
But Jehu no take care to waka for di law of di Lord, di God of Israel, with all im heart. E no turn away from di sins of Jeroboam wey e use make Israel sin.
For dem days di Lord begin to cut Israel small. Hazael strike dem for all di border of Israel,
from Jordan toward di east, all Gilead land, di Gadites, and di Reubenites, and di Manassites, from Aroer, wey dey beside Arnon valley, even Gilead and Bashan.
Di rest of wetin Jehu do, and all wey e do, and all im power, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
Jehu die join im papa dem, and dem bury am for Samaria. Im pikin Jehoahaz rule for im place.
Di days wey Jehu rule over Israel for Samaria na 28 years.
As Athaliah, Ahaziah mama, see say im pikin don die, e stand up and destroy all di royal children.

But Jehosheba, King Joram pikin, Ahaziah sister, take Joash, Ahaziah pikin, and steal am from among di king pikin dem wey dem dey kill, and put am and im nurse for di bedroom. Dem hide am from Athaliah, so dem no kill am.
E dey with am hide for di Lord house six years. Athaliah dey rule over di land.

For di seventh year Jehoiada send call di captains of hundreds, of di Carites and of di guards, and bring dem to am for di Lord house. E make covenant with dem, make dem swear for di Lord house, and show dem di king pikin.
E command dem say, “Dis na di thing wey una go do: one third of una wey dey come in on Sabbath go keep watch over di king house,
and one third go dey for di Sur gate, and one third for di gate behind di guards. So una go keep watch over di house, to stop people from entering.
Di two groups of una wey dey go out on Sabbath go keep watch over di Lord house round di king.
Una go surround di king round, every man with im weapons for im hand, and anybody wey enter di ranks, make dem kill am. Make una dey with di king as e dey go out and as e dey come in.”
Di captains of hundreds do all wey Jehoiada di priest command. Each one take im men, di ones wey dey come in on Sabbath, with di ones wey dey go out on Sabbath, and dem come to Jehoiada di priest.
Di priest give di captains of hundreds King David spears and shields wey dey di Lord house.
Di guards stand, every man with im weapons for im hand, from di right side of di house reach di left side of di house, by di altar and di house, round di king.
Den e bring out di king pikin, put di crown on am, give am di covenant, and dem make am king and anoint am. Dem clap dem hands and talk say, “Make di king live long!”
As Athaliah hear di noise of di guards and of di people, e come to di people for di Lord house.

E look, and look, di king dey stand by di pillar, as dem dey do am, and di captains and di trumpets dey by di king. All di people of di land dey rejoice and dey blow trumpets. Athaliah tear im clothes and cry say, “Treason! Treason!”

Jehoiada di priest command di captains of hundreds wey dey over di army say, “Bring am out between di ranks, and anybody wey follow am, kill am with sword.” Because di priest talk say, “Make dem no kill am for di Lord house.”
So dem lay hands on am, and e go by di way wey di horses dey enter di king house, and dem kill am there.
Jehoiada make covenant between di Lord and di king and di people, say dem go be di Lord people, and between di king and di people too.

All di people of di land go to di house of Baal and break am down. Dem break im altars and im images to pieces well well, and dem kill Mattan, di priest of Baal, before di altars. Di priest put guards over di Lord house.

E take di captains of hundreds, and di Carites, and di guards, and all di people of di land, and dem bring di king down from di Lord house, and dem come by di way of di gate of di guards to di king house. E sit for di throne of di kings.
All di people of di land rejoice, and di city dey quiet. Dem don kill Athaliah with sword for di king house.
Jehoash be seven years old as e begin to rule.
For di seventh year of Jehu, Jehoash begin to rule, and e rule 40 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Zibiah from Beersheba.
Jehoash do wetin good for di Lord eyes all di days wey Jehoiada di priest teach am.
Only di high places dem no remove. Di people still dey make sacrifice and burn incense for di high places.

Jehoash talk to di priests say, “All di money of di holy things wey dem dey bring come di Lord house, di money wey every man dey pay, di money for which every man be counted, and all di money wey e dey come to any man heart to bring come di Lord house,
make di priests take am to dem, every man from im friend, and make dem repair wetin don break for di house, wherever dem find anything wey don break.”
But e happen say for di 23rd year of King Jehoash, di priests never repair wetin don break for di house.

Den King Jehoash call Jehoiada di priest and di other priests and talk to dem say, “Why una no repair wetin don break for di house? Now no take money again from una friends, but give am for di repair of di house.”
Di priests agree say dem no go take money again from di people and say dem no go repair di house.

But Jehoiada di priest take one chest, bore hole for im lid and put am beside di altar, for di right side as one dey enter di Lord house. Di priests wey dey keep di door put inside am all di money wey dem bring come di Lord house.
E happen say as dem see say money plenty for di chest, di king secretary and di high priest come up, tie am up and count di money wey dem find for di Lord house.
Dem give di money wey dem don weigh into di hands of di ones wey do di work, wey dey take care of di Lord house. Dem pay am to di carpenters and di builders wey dey work for di Lord house,
and to di masons and di stone cutters, and to buy wood and cut stone to repair wetin don break for di Lord house, and for all wey dem spend for di house to repair am.
But dem no make for di Lord house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, or any gold or silver vessels from di money wey dem bring come di Lord house,
because dem give am to di ones wey do di work, and dem use am repair di Lord house.
Dem no ask di men, into wey hands dem give di money to pay di workers, to account, because dem dey work with faithfulness.
Di money for guilt offerings and di money for sin offerings no come di Lord house. E belong to di priests.
Den Hazael king of Syria go up and fight against Gath and take am, and Hazael set im face to go up against Jerusalem.

Jehoash king of Judah take all di holy things wey im papa dem, Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, kings of Judah, don give to God, and im own holy things, and all di gold wey dem find for di treasures of di Lord house and di king house, and send am to Hazael king of Syria. Den e go away from Jerusalem.
Di rest of wetin Joash do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
Im servants stand up, make plot and strike Joash for Beth Millo, as e dey go down to Silla.
Jozacar, Shimeath pikin, and Jehozabad, Shomer pikin, im servants, strike am, and e die. Dem bury am with im papa dem for David city, and im pikin Amaziah rule for im place.
For di 23rd year of Joash, Ahaziah pikin, king of Judah, Jehoahaz, Jehu pikin, begin to rule over Israel for Samaria, and e rule 17 years.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, and follow di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin. E no turn away from dem.
Di anger of di Lord burn against Israel, and e give dem into di hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into di hand of Ben Hadad, Hazael pikin, all dia days.
Jehoahaz beg di Lord, and di Lord listen to am, because e see di suffering of Israel, as di king of Syria dey press dem.
Di Lord give Israel one savior, so dem comot from under di hand of di Syrians, and Israel pikin dem stay for dem tents as before.
Still, dem no turn from di sins of Jeroboam house, wey e use make Israel sin. Dem waka for dem, and di Asherah pole still dey stand for Samaria too.
Because e no leave any army for Jehoahaz except 50 horsemen, ten chariots and 10,000 foot soldiers, because di king of Syria don destroy dem and make dem like dust for threshing.
Di rest of wetin Jehoahaz do, and all wey e do, and im power, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
Jehoahaz die join im papa dem, and dem bury am for Samaria. Im pikin Joash rule for im place.
For di 37th year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash, Jehoahaz pikin, begin to rule over Israel for Samaria, and e rule 16 years.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes. E no turn away from all di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin. E waka for dem.
Di rest of wetin Joash do, and all wey e do, and im power wey e use fight against Amaziah king of Judah, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
Joash die join im papa dem, and Jeroboam sit for im throne. Dem bury Joash for Samaria with di kings of Israel.
Now Elisha fall sick with di sickness wey e go die from. Joash king of Israel come down to am, cry over am and talk say, “My papa, my papa, di chariots of Israel and im horsemen!”
Elisha talk to am say, “Take bow and arrows.” E take bow and arrows for imself.
E talk to di king of Israel say, “Put your hand on di bow.” E put im hand on am, and Elisha put im hands on di king hands.

E talk say, “Open di window toward di east.” E open am. Den Elisha talk say, “Shoot.” E shoot. E talk say, “Di Lord arrow of victory, di arrow of victory over Syria, because you go strike di Syrians for Aphek until you finish dem.”
E talk say, “Take di arrows.” E take dem. E talk to di king of Israel say, “Strike di ground.” E strike three times and stop.
Di man of God vex with am and talk say, “You for strike five or six times. Den you for strike Syria until you finish dem, but now you go strike Syria only three times.”
Elisha die and dem bury am. Now bands of Moabites dey invade di land for di coming of di year.
E happen say as dem dey bury one man, look, dem see one band, and dem throw di man into Elisha grave. As di man touch Elisha bones, e come back to life and stand up for im feet.
Hazael king of Syria press Israel all di days of Jehoahaz.
But di Lord show dem grace and pity dem, and turn to dem because of im covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. E no wan destroy dem, and e no throw dem away from im face till now.
Hazael king of Syria die, and im pikin Ben Hadad rule for im place.
Jehoash, Jehoahaz pikin, take back from di hand of Ben Hadad, Hazael pikin, di cities wey e take from Jehoahaz im papa for war. Three times Joash strike am, and e recover di cities of Israel.
For di second year of Joash, Joahaz pikin, king of Israel, Amaziah, Joash pikin, king of Judah, begin to rule.
E be 25 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 29 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Jehoaddin from Jerusalem.
E do wetin good for di Lord eyes, but no like David im papa. E do all as im papa Joash do.
Only di high places dem no remove. Di people still dey make sacrifice and burn incense for di high places.
E happen say as di kingdom don stand strong for im hand, e kill im servants wey kill di king im papa.

But e no kill di pikin dem of di murderers, as e write for di book of di law of Moses, wey di Lord command say, “Dem no go kill papa dem for pikin dem, and dem no go kill pikin dem for papa dem, but every man go die for im own sin.”
E strike ten thousand Edomites for di Valley of Salt, and take Sela for war, and call am Joktheel till today.
Den Amaziah send messengers to Jehoash, Jehoahaz pikin, Jehu pikin, king of Israel, say, “Come, make we look each other for face.”

Jehoash king of Israel send to Amaziah king of Judah say, “Di thistle wey dey Lebanon send to di cedar wey dey Lebanon say, ‘Give your daughter to my pikin as wife.’ Den one wild animal wey dey Lebanon pass and trample di thistle.
You don strike Edom, and your heart don lift you up. Enjoy your glory and stay for house. Why you go provoke trouble, so that you go fall, you and Judah with you?”
But Amaziah no listen. So Jehoash king of Israel go up, and e and Amaziah king of Judah look each other for face for Beth Shemesh, wey belong to Judah.
Judah lose before Israel, and dem run, every man to im tent.

Jehoash king of Israel catch Amaziah king of Judah, Jehoash pikin, Ahaziah pikin, for Beth Shemesh, and come Jerusalem and break down di wall of Jerusalem from di gate of Ephraim reach di Corner Gate, 400 cubits.
E take all di gold and silver and all di vessels wey dem find for di Lord house and for di treasures of di king house, with hostages, and return to Samaria.
Di rest of wetin Jehoash do, wey e do, and im power, and how e fight with Amaziah king of Judah, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
Jehoash die join im papa dem and dem bury am for Samaria with di kings of Israel, and im pikin Jeroboam rule for im place.
Amaziah, Joash pikin, king of Judah, live 15 years after di death of Jehoash, Jehoahaz pikin, king of Israel.
Di rest of wetin Amaziah do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
Dem make plot against am for Jerusalem, and e run go Lachish, but dem send after am go Lachish and kill am there.
Dem carry am on horses, and e dem bury am for Jerusalem with im papa dem for David city.
All di people of Judah take Azariah, wey be 16 years old, and make am king for im papa Amaziah place.
E build Elath and return am to Judah, after di king die join im papa dem.
For di 15th year of Amaziah, Joash pikin, king of Judah, Jeroboam, Joash pikin, king of Israel, begin to rule for Samaria, and e rule 41 years.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes. E no turn away from all di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin.

E restore di border of Israel from di entrance of Hamath reach di sea of di Arabah, as di word of di Lord, di God of Israel, wey e talk by im servant Jonah, Amittai pikin, di prophet, wey come from Gath Hepher.
Because di Lord see say di suffering of Israel dey very bitter, and nobody remain, no slave and no free, and nobody dey to help Israel.
Di Lord no talk say e go wipe out di name of Israel from under heaven, so e save dem by di hand of Jeroboam, Joash pikin.

Di rest of wetin Jeroboam do, and all wey e do, and im power, how e fight, and how e take back Damascus and Hamath for Judah wey belong to Israel, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
Jeroboam die join im papa dem, even di kings of Israel, and im pikin Zechariah rule for im place.
For di 27th year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah, Amaziah pikin, king of Judah, begin to rule.
E be 16 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 52 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Jecholiah from Jerusalem.
E do wetin good for di Lord eyes, as all im papa Amaziah do.
Only di high places dem no remove. Di people still dey make sacrifice and burn incense for di high places.
Di Lord strike di king, so tay e get leprosy till di day wey e die, and e dey stay for separate house. Jotham, di king pikin, dey over di house and dey judge di people of di land.
Di rest of wetin Azariah do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
Azariah die join im papa dem, and dem bury am with im papa dem for David city, and im pikin Jotham rule for im place.
For di 38th year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah, Jeroboam pikin, begin to rule over Israel for Samaria six months.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, as im papa dem do. E no turn away from di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin.
Shallum, Jabesh pikin, make plot against am, strike am before di people, kill am and rule for im place.
Di rest of wetin Zechariah do, look, dem write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel.
Dis na di word of di Lord wey e talk to Jehu say, “Your pikin dem to di fourth generation go sit for di throne of Israel.” E happen so.
Shallum, Jabesh pikin, begin to rule for di 39th year of Uzziah king of Judah, and e rule one month for Samaria.
Menahem, Gadi pikin, go up from Tirzah, come Samaria, strike Shallum, Jabesh pikin, for Samaria, kill am and rule for im place.
Di rest of wetin Shallum do, and im plot wey e plan, look, dem write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel.
Den Menahem strike Tiphsah, and all wey dey inside am, and im border from Tirzah, because dem no open to am. E strike am, and e cut open all di pregnant women for am.
For di 39th year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem, Gadi pikin, begin to rule over Israel, and e rule ten years for Samaria.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes. E no turn away all im days from di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin.
Pul king of Assyria come against di land, and Menahem give Pul 1,000 talents of silver, so that im hand go dey with am to make di kingdom stand strong for im hand.
Menahem collect di money from Israel, from all di rich men, 50 shekels of silver from each man, to give to di king of Assyria. So di king of Assyria go back and no stay for di land.
Di rest of wetin Menahem do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
Menahem die join im papa dem, and im pikin Pekahiah rule for im place.
For di 50th year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah, Menahem pikin, begin to rule over Israel for Samaria, and e rule two years.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes. E no turn away from di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin.

Pekah, Remaliah pikin, im captain, make plot against am and strike am for Samaria, for di strong part of di king house, with Argob and Arieh, and 50 men of di Gileadites with am. E kill am and rule for im place.
Di rest of wetin Pekahiah do, and all wey e do, look, dem write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel.
For di 52nd year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah, Remaliah pikin, begin to rule over Israel for Samaria, and e rule 20 years.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes. E no turn away from di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin.

For di days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria come and take Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, Galilee, all Naphtali land, and carry dem go Assyria as prisoners.
Hoshea, Elah pikin, make plot against Pekah, Remaliah pikin, strike am, kill am and rule for im place, for di 20th year of Jotham, Uzziah pikin.
Di rest of wetin Pekah do, and all wey e do, look, dem write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel.
For di second year of Pekah, Remaliah pikin, king of Israel, Jotham, Uzziah pikin, king of Judah, begin to rule.
E be 25 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 16 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Jerusha, Zadok pikin.
E do wetin good for di Lord eyes. E do as all im papa Uzziah do.
Only di high places dem no remove. Di people still dey make sacrifice and burn incense for di high places. E build di upper gate of di Lord house.
Di rest of wetin Jotham do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
For dem days di Lord begin to send Rezin king of Syria and Pekah, Remaliah pikin, against Judah.
Jotham die join im papa dem, and dem bury am with im papa dem for di city of David im papa, and im pikin Ahaz rule for im place.
For di 17th year of Pekah, Remaliah pikin, Ahaz, Jotham pikin, king of Judah, begin to rule.
Ahaz be 20 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 16 years for Jerusalem. E no do wetin good for di Lord im God eyes, like David im papa.
But e waka for di way of di kings of Israel, and e make im pikin pass through fire, as di disgusting ways of di nations wey di Lord drive out before Israel pikin dem.
E make sacrifice and burn incense for di high places, and for di hills, and under every green tree.
Den Rezin king of Syria and Pekah, Remaliah pikin, king of Israel, come up to Jerusalem to fight, and dem surround Ahaz, but dem no fit win am.
For dat time Rezin king of Syria take back Elath for Syria, and drive di men of Judah comot from Elath. Di Edomites come Elath and dey stay there till today.

So Ahaz send messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria say, “I be your servant and your pikin. Come up and save me from di hand of di king of Syria and from di hand of di king of Israel, wey dey rise against me.”
Ahaz take di silver and gold wey dem find for di Lord house and for di treasures of di king house and send am as gift to di king of Assyria.
Di king of Assyria listen to am. Di king of Assyria go up against Damascus, take am, carry im people go Kir as prisoners and kill Rezin.

King Ahaz go Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and e see di altar wey dey Damascus. King Ahaz send to Uriah di priest di picture of di altar, and di plan of am, according to all di work of am.
Uriah di priest build altar. According to all wey King Ahaz send from Damascus, so Uriah di priest make am before King Ahaz come back from Damascus.
As di king come from Damascus, di king see di altar, and di king come near di altar and offer sacrifice for am.
E burn im burnt sacrifice and im grain sacrifice, pour im drink offering and sprinkle di blood of im peace sacrifices for di altar.
Di bronze altar wey dey before di Lord, e bring am from di front of di house, from between di altar and di Lord house, and put am for di north side of di altar.

King Ahaz command Uriah di priest say, “Burn on di big altar di morning burnt sacrifice, and di evening grain sacrifice, and di king burnt sacrifice and im grain sacrifice, with di burnt sacrifice of all di people of di land, and dem grain sacrifice, and dem drink offering. Sprinkle on am all di blood of di burnt sacrifice and all di blood of di sacrifice. But di bronze altar go be for me to ask di Lord.”
Uriah di priest do all as King Ahaz command.
King Ahaz cut off di panels of di bases, and remove di basin from dem. E take down di sea from di bronze oxen wey dey under am and put am on stone pavement.
Di covered way for Sabbath wey dem build for di house, and di king outer entrance, e turn am from di Lord house because of di king of Assyria.
Di rest of wetin Ahaz do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
Ahaz die join im papa dem, and dem bury am with im papa dem for David city, and im pikin Hezekiah rule for im place.
For di 12th year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea, Elah pikin, begin to rule over Israel for Samaria, and e rule nine years.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, but no like di kings of Israel wey dey before am.
Shalmaneser king of Assyria come up against am, and Hoshea become im servant and pay am tribute.

But di king of Assyria discover treason for Hoshea, because e send messengers to So king of Egypt and no pay tribute to di king of Assyria as e dey do year by year. So di king of Assyria lock am up and tie am for prison.
Den di king of Assyria go up through all di land, go up to Samaria and surround am three years.
For di ninth year of Hoshea, di king of Assyria take Samaria and carry Israel go Assyria as prisoners and put dem for Halah, and for Habor, di river of Gozan, and for di cities of di Medes.
E happen so because Israel pikin dem don sin against di Lord dem God, wey bring dem up from Egypt land, from under di hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and dem fear other gods,
and waka for di customs of di nations wey di Lord drive out before Israel pikin dem, and for di customs of di kings of Israel wey dem make.
Israel pikin dem do secretly things wey no right against di Lord dem God, and dem build high places for demselves for all dem cities, from di watchtower reach di strong city.
Dem set up pillars and Asherah poles for demselves for every high hill and under every green tree,
and dem burn incense for all di high places, as di nations wey di Lord carry away before dem, and dem do wicked things to make di Lord vex.
Dem serve idols, wey di Lord talk to dem say, “Una no go do dis thing.”

Still di Lord warn Israel and Judah by all di prophets and by every seer say, “Turn from una evil ways and keep my commands and my laws, as all di law wey I command una papa dem, and wey I send to una by my servants di prophets.”
But dem no hear, but dem make dem neck hard like di neck of dem papa dem, wey no believe di Lord dem God.

Dem reject im laws and im covenant wey e make with dem papa dem, and im warnings wey e warn dem. Dem follow worthless things and become worthless, and follow di nations wey dey round dem, about wey di Lord command dem say make dem no do like dem.
Dem leave all di commands of di Lord dem God, and make idols of melted metal for demselves, two calves, and make Asherah pole, and worship all di army of heaven and serve Baal.
Dem make dem sons and dem daughters pass through fire, and use fortune telling and witchcraft, and sell demselves to do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, to make am vex.
So di Lord vex well well with Israel and remove dem from im sight. None remain except Judah tribe only.
Judah too no keep di commands of di Lord dem God, but dem waka for di customs of Israel wey dem make.
Di Lord reject all di descendants of Israel, punish dem and give dem into di hand of robbers, until e don throw dem away from im sight.
Because e tear Israel from David house, and dem make Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, king. Jeroboam drive Israel from following di Lord and make dem sin big sin.
Israel pikin dem waka for all di sins of Jeroboam wey e do. Dem no turn from dem,
until di Lord remove Israel from im sight, as e talk by all im servants di prophets. So Israel dey carry away from dem own land go Assyria till today.

Di king of Assyria bring people from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Avva, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim and put dem for di cities of Samaria for Israel pikin dem place. Dem take Samaria and dey stay for im cities.
E happen for di beginning of dem stay there say dem no fear di Lord. So di Lord send lions among dem, wey kill some of dem.

So dem talk to di king of Assyria say, “Di nations wey you don carry away and put for di cities of Samaria no know di custom of di God of di land. So e don send lions among dem, and look, dem dey kill dem, because dem no know di custom of di God of di land.”
Den di king of Assyria command say, “Carry go one of di priests wey una carry from dia, make dem go stay dia, and make e teach dem di custom of di God of di land.”
So one of di priests wey dem carry from Samaria come stay for Bethel, and teach dem how dem go fear di Lord.
But every nation still make dem own gods and put dem for di houses of di high places wey di Samaritans make, every nation for dem cities wia dem dey stay.
Di men of Babylon make Succoth Benoth, di men of Cuth make Nergal, di men of Hamath make Ashima,
di Avvites make Nibhaz and Tartak, and di Sepharvites burn dem children for fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, di gods of Sepharvaim.
So dem fear di Lord, and make priests of di high places from among all dem, wey dey make sacrifice for dem for di houses of di high places.
Dem fear di Lord and serve dem own gods, as di custom of di nations wey dem carry from dia.
Till today dem still dey do as di old customs. Dem no fear di Lord, and dem no do as dem laws, or dem rules, or di law and di command wey di Lord command Jacob pikin dem, wey e name Israel,
wey di Lord make covenant with, and command dem say, “Una no go fear other gods, or bow down to dem, or serve dem, or make sacrifice to dem.
But di Lord, wey bring una up from Egypt land with great power and stretched out arm, na im una go fear, and na im una go bow down to, and na to am una go make sacrifice.
Di laws and di rules and di law and di commands wey e write for una, una go take care to do dem always, and una no go fear other gods.
Di covenant wey I make with una, una no go forget am, and una no go fear other gods.
But di Lord una God na im una go fear, and e go save una from di hand of all una enemies.”
But dem no listen, but dem do as dem old custom.
So dem nations fear di Lord and serve dem idols. Dem pikin dem and dem pikin pikin dem do till today as dem papa dem do.
